description: Commits selected files within selected workspace items to the connected Git repository.
notes: Commit is LRO (returns 202, polls until Succeeded/Failed). Use --commit-all, --items ID1,ID2, or --items-with-file-selection JSON; the three modes are mutually exclusive. selectedFiles paths are relative to the item root. An empty or null selectedFiles commits every file in that item. workspaceHead is auto-fetched from Git status.

query_examples.description: Error details if failed (null on success).
